name: Biophysics Graduate Program (PhD)
summary: Interdisciplinary biophysics training with first-year laboratory rotations before choosing a research advisor.

deadlines.label: Fall 2027 application deadline
deadlines.note: Central table confirms Fall 2027. Program page has an inconsistent fall-2026 label despite explicit December 1, 2026 deadline and 2027 interviews.

applicationFee.note: $120 for U.S. citizens/permanent residents; $140 international. International applicants are not eligible for central fee waivers. Request eligible waivers at least two weeks before the deadline.

english.toefl: 5.0 for tests on or after January 21, 2026; 80 for earlier tests
english.note: TOEFL/IELTS exemptions may apply for qualifying English-language education. Tests must be valid on the application deadline; electronic results only. Duolingo, TOEFL Home Edition and MyBest scores are not accepted.

documents: Personal statement or statement of purpose
requirements.note: A bachelor’s degree or equivalent and normally at least a 3.0 GPA are required. Only one UCSF graduate program application per cycle. Unofficial transcripts may be used for review; final official transcripts are due after admission. Foreign transcripts require an approved credential evaluation; check program-specific timing. Program may consider exceptions to the 3.0 GPA threshold.

timeline.interviews: Preliminary Zoom interviews January 29 and February 5, 2027; admitted-student visit March 11–13, 2027.

international.note: Central policy currently says UCSF cannot process applications from people located in Iran or ordinarily resident in Iran; see official international admissions policy.

funding.note: All admitted students receive a stipend plus tuition and fees, subject to maintaining good standing. Published stipend is for 2025–2026, not a Fall 2027 rate.
